messages:
Samir: kicking off new-region bootstrap for eu-central-2 — main focus: GitOps helm sync + image registry replication. Need checklist and owners. :rocket:

sre-jen: +1. we should capture artifact replication, registry auth, firewall, and GPU quota request steps. do we have a repeatable job for images? :eyes:

Alex: we have artifact-replicator (k8s CronJob) but last time it failed on auth when the target registry rotated creds. ensure the replication SA has long-lived key or we use workload identity. also watch for blob/blob-tier differences for large model shards.

Maria: i'll own registry auth. plan: create cross-project service account, bind Storage Admin, generate short-lived token via ops-ci. ping me for the SA name.

Samir: thanks. Alex — can you post the helm commands we'll run for the initial chart sync? include values overrides for nodepools (gpu) and taints.

Alex: sure. snippet we'll run from the bootstrap runner:```bash
helm repo add redwood-charts https://charts.redwood.example.com
helm pull redwood-charts/cluster-base --version 4.2.0
helm upgrade --install cluster-base redwood-charts/cluster-base -f values-eu-central-2.yaml --namespace infra --create-namespace
# values-eu-central-2.yaml contains nodePools, taints, kubeletFlags, registryMirror
```

sre-jen: validation steps: 1) nodepools up with GPU sku and taints 2) registry mirror reachable from nodes (curl + docker pull) 3) imagePullSecrets present in infra namespace 4) KV cache and NFS mounts validate 5) smoke pipeline (small inference job) green. keep failures loud.

deploy-bot: deployment job 1769654321-helm-sync started by Samir — check pipeline: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/1769654321

Alex: note on image replication: we mirror OCI images with the replicator using `skopeo copy --all` to keep manifests and multi-arch. sometimes layers are re-compressed causing size change; our checksum-based validation step must compare manifest digests across registries.

Maria: cost note: cross-region egress for pulling large model layers will add up. recommend pre-warming local registry in eu-central-2 with the 10 most used model images and enabling content addressing/immutable tags to avoid re-push. we should estimate egress: ~120TB for initial sync -> ~ $Xk. ops, confirm billing tag.

ops-ci: added a runbook page & ticket template: https://confluence.redwood/internal/infra/bootstrap-region (perm: eng-infra). includes GPU quota request template, expected VLAN ranges, and NAT egress plan.

Samir: handoff checklist draft:
- registry replication: owner Maria, SA created, test pull success
- helm/GitOps: helm chart versions pinned, PR reviewed, repo webhook to argocd
- argocd: app created with path clusters/eu-central-2, sync policy manual until smoke green
- infra tests: nodepool autoscaler, PDBs, podDisruptionBudget checks
- GPU quota: ticket to cloud with exact SKU list and test tokens
- monitoring: create Datadog dashboards + alerts for high image-pull failures, node OOMs

sre-jen: add security checks: ensure registry TLS fingerprints, KMS key policy, and private network egress rules. also restrict who can push to the mirrored registry.

Maria: i'll start SA and push first small image as smoke. tagging conv: `eu-central-2/<image>:mirror-<sha>`

Alex: once mirror is verified, we'll enable argocd auto-sync for infra namespace and flip workloads one-by-one. keep canary for model-serving pods with fallback to hosted models. :thumbsup:

Samir: great. next steps: Maria to create SA + test pull by EOD, Alex to prepare helm PR, Jen to open GPU quota ticket. will update thread with CI link. thanks all.
